craft_notes: Sthāyin: hail mid-count (vocative chosen). Rows: hail then span. Rejected: bare nominative — killed: adjudicated address. Read aloud: hail then measure.

lines: That day; above it hail, O Rudra-world's lord! —
Rudra's; that long the night; year as before; that hundred too the bound.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tat dinaṃ tadūrdhve rudralokaprabho rudrasya tāvatī rātriḥ prāgvat varṣaṃ tacchatam api ca avadhiḥ
